messages:
Anya: Quick sync — trying to lock Q3 scope for Console observability OKRs. Need consensus on dashboards, traces, error analysis, and retention tiers by Friday. Customers asking for longer traces + cheaper dashboard views.
Sam: +1. Main constraints: query latency at scale and storage cost for long trace retention. We can ship a tiered retention model but need sampling + archive strategy.
Devon: FYI SRE asked for a hard budget cap on telemetry ingest. If we don’t add sampling, ops costs jump. Can we do adaptive sampling?
Marcos: Adaptive sampling looks promising. We can keep full traces for p95 errors and sampled traces for success flows. Metric: maintain recall on regressions >= 95%.
Liz: UX tradeoff — users want seamless time-range switching (1h -> 30d) without huge load. Suggest precomputed rollups for dashboards and deferred trace fetch for older ranges.
Anya: Proposed scope: (1) Dashboards: precomputed rollups + query profiling, (2) Traces: 14d default hot retention, 90d archived w/ on-demand restore, (3) Error analysis: anomaly alerts + quick diff view, (4) Ops: adaptive sampling + budget guardrails. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Sam: Technical concerns: archive/restore adds infra work. We can use object-store tiering + async restore. Need exact SLAs for restores (e.g., <6h). Also indexing strategy for archived traces.
Devon: Can we expose a "restore ETA" and a fallback visualization that shows metadata while full trace restores? That reduces user pain.
Marcos: For rollouts, recommend A/Bing retention tiers to top 10 customers first and measure cost delta and regression recall. We'll instrument with 3 metrics: median query latency, cost per 1M spans, and regression recall.
Liz: Launch criteria from UX side: baseline task completion <2 clicks for common flows, and restore/fallback UX documented. Also need error-state illustrations.
Anya: Customer-driven asks prioritized: (A) longer retention for compliance, (B) cheaper dashboard reads, (C) anomaly-first alerts. We should map these to OKRs: reduce customer telemetry cost by 30% (KR), increase retention SLAs sold by 2 tiers (KR), and reduce dashboard median load time to <350ms (KR).
Sam: Implementation phases suggestion: Phase 1 (Q3 alpha) - rollups + adaptive sampling + basic archive pipeline. Phase 2 (Q4) - archive restore UX + A/B with customers + advanced alerting.
Devon: Risk list: restore latency, index bloat, unexpected egress costs. Mitigations: rate limits, retention quotas, and canary on small traffic.
Anya: Action items: Sam to sketch infra plan & effort estimate by Tue, Marcos to draft A/B metrics and measurement plan, Liz to prototype restore fallback UX, Devon to draft SRE guardrails and budget thresholds. I'll consolidate into a spec doc and OKR draft.
obs-bot: Reminder: #observability-roadmap doc created: /docs/obs-q3-specs (auto).
Anya: Thanks — I'll run this at the PM triage tomorrow. If anyone has strong objections to the 14d/90d split, flag here. :thumbsup:
